sn32.2:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn32.2:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā valāhakakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 4
sn32.2:1.4: Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati vācāya sucaritaṃ carati manasā sucaritaṃ carati ||
sn32.2:1.6: Valāhakakāyikā devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahutā ti || || 5
sn32.2:1.8: Ahovatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā valāhakakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam uppajjeyyanti || ||
sn32.2:1.9: So kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā valāhakakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam uppajjatīti || || 6
sn32.2:1.10: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā valāhakakāyikānam devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 1-3
